blocks.zh: Section 5B: Tubular Vials — Nonconformity Lexicon Part 2 (管制小瓶不符合項詞典 第二部分)
blocks.en: Section 5B: Tubular Vials — Nonconformity Lexicon Part 2

blocks.zh: 🎯 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: 🎯 Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 識別並解釋 TR43 第 8.5 節管制小瓶 (Tubular Vial) 的全部不符合項詞彙，掌握各缺陷的定義、分類標準與量測方法。
blocks.en: Identify and explain all the nonconformity terms for tubular vials in TR43 Section 8.5, and master the definition, classification criteria and measurement method of each defect.

blocks.zh: 理解即用型 (RTU) 小瓶在污染、鬆散玻璃等關鍵缺陷上，與傳統未洗滌容器分類等級的差異，以及其監管依據。
blocks.en: Understand how the classification of key defects such as contamination and loose glass differs between ready-to-use (RTU) vials and conventional unwashed containers, and the regulatory basis for this.

blocks.zh: 比較 TR43 涵蓋的五種容器類型（模製瓶、安瓿、卡匣管、針筒、管制小瓶），整合各容器的特有缺陷關注點。
blocks.en: Compare the five container types covered by TR43 (moulded vials, ampoules, cartridge tubes, syringes, tubular vials) and consolidate the specific defect concerns of each.

blocks.zh: 應用 TR43 詞典建立 CDMO 進廠驗收 (Incoming Inspection) 計畫，並了解如何將 AQL 抽樣方案與缺陷嚴重度分級整合運用。
blocks.en: Use the TR43 lexicon to build a CDMO incoming inspection plan, and understand how to integrate AQL sampling plans with defect severity classification.

blocks.zh: Critical 重大
blocks.en: Critical

blocks.zh: Major A 主要A
blocks.en: Major A

blocks.zh: Major B 主要B
blocks.en: Major B

blocks.zh: Minor 次要
blocks.en: Minor

blocks.zh: Acceptable Imperfection 可接受瑕疵
blocks.en: Acceptable Imperfection

blocks.zh: 📚 教育解說 — 第二部分導引
blocks.en: 📚 Educational Commentary — Introduction to Part 2

blocks.zh: 延續第一部分：第二部分的學習定位
blocks.en: Continuing from Part 1: the role of Part 2

blocks.zh: 本頁 (Section 5B) 是管制小瓶 (Tubular Vial) 詞典的第二部分，延續 Section 5A 的詞彙，涵蓋字母順序後段的缺陷條目（A–Z 完整詞彙），以及針對 RTU（Ready-to-Use） 即用型小瓶的特殊分類規定。
blocks.en: This page (Section 5B) is Part 2 of the tubular vial lexicon. It continues the terms of Section 5A, covers the later alphabetical entries (the complete A–Z vocabulary), and addresses the special classification rules for RTU (Ready-to-Use) vials.

blocks.zh: TR43 Section 8.5 是本報告的最後一個容器類型章節，理解本節後，您將完整掌握 TR43 所涵蓋的所有五種主要玻璃初級包裝容器的不符合項詞典。
blocks.en: TR43 Section 8.5 is the last container-type section of this report. After this section, you will have a complete grasp of the nonconformity lexicons for all five main glass primary packaging container types covered by TR43.

blocks.zh: A–F 本頁前半段：Adhered Glass → Flared Shoulder（含 Contamination 雙版本）
blocks.en: A–F, first half of this page: Adhered Glass → Flared Shoulder (including both versions of Contamination)

blocks.zh: F–Z 下方後半段：Frost → Wavy Bottom（含 RTU-specific 條目）
blocks.en: F–Z, second half below: Frost → Wavy Bottom (including RTU-specific entries)

blocks.zh: RTU 關鍵差異：Contamination (RTU) 與 Loose Glass (RTU) 的嚴重度升高
blocks.en: Key RTU difference: higher severity for Contamination (RTU) and Loose Glass (RTU)

blocks.zh: ⚠️ RTU 小瓶的核心差異：為何標準更嚴格？
blocks.en: ⚠️ The core difference for RTU vials: why are the criteria stricter?

blocks.zh: TR43 為 RTU 容器設立獨立的不符合項條目，原因如下：
blocks.en: TR43 sets up separate nonconformity entries for RTU containers, for the following reasons:

blocks.zh: 傳統容器：在製藥廠灌裝前，必須經過洗滌 (Washing) 與除熱原 (Depyrogenation) 步驟。即使進廠時含有少量鬆散玻璃粒或可移除污染物，後續製程可清除。
blocks.en: Conventional containers: before filling at the pharmaceutical plant, they must go through washing and depyrogenation steps. Even if a small amount of loose glass particles or removable contamination is present on receipt, the downstream process can remove it.

blocks.zh: RTU 容器：玻璃製造商已完成洗滌、矽化及滅菌，直接以無菌方式（通常置於特殊托盤或巢架中）出貨。製藥廠收到後，不進行二次洗滌。
blocks.en: RTU containers: the glass manufacturer has already completed washing, siliconization and sterilization, and ships them aseptically (usually in special trays or nests). The pharmaceutical plant, on receipt, performs no further washing.

blocks.zh: 因此，RTU 容器的內表面潔淨度要求等同於已完成 DI Water / WFI 洗滌的潔淨品質。任何殘留物對藥品的風險不再受下游洗滌步驟緩解。
blocks.en: The requirement for interior surface cleanliness of RTU containers is therefore equivalent to the cleanliness of a container that has already been washed with DI water / WFI. The risk of any residue to the drug product is no longer mitigated by a downstream washing step.

blocks.zh: TR43 表 8.0-5 明確為 Bulk/Unwashed 與 RTU 各建立獨立條目，以反映製程流程的實質差異。
blocks.en: TR43 Table 8.0-5 explicitly establishes separate entries for Bulk/Unwashed and RTU to reflect the substantive difference in process flow.

blocks.zh: 💡 比喻：RTU 小瓶 = 預先打掃好的飯店客房
blocks.en: 💡 Analogy: an RTU vial = a hotel room that has been cleaned in advance

blocks.zh: 想像您預訂了一間聲稱「已清潔消毒完畢」的高檔飯店客房：
blocks.en: Imagine you book a high-end hotel room that is advertised as "already cleaned and disinfected":

blocks.zh: 您進入時，發現地板上有一根頭髮、桌上有殘留飲料漬。飯店說「本來就很乾淨了」，但您沒有辦法也不應該需要再打掃。
blocks.en: When you enter, you find a hair on the floor and a drink stain on the table. The hotel says "it was already clean", but you cannot, and should not need to, clean it again.

blocks.zh: 這就是 RTU 小瓶的邏輯：玻璃製造商就是那個飯店，已完成清潔的承諾。
blocks.en: This is the logic of RTU vials: the glass manufacturer is the hotel, which has made the promise of cleanliness.

blocks.zh: 製藥廠就是住客——他們相信客房已清潔，直接「入住」（灌裝藥液）。一旦客房本身不乾淨，後果直接由最終使用者（患者）承擔。
blocks.en: The pharmaceutical plant is the guest. It trusts that the room is clean and "checks in" directly (fills the drug solution). If the room itself is not clean, the consequences fall directly on the end user (the patient).

blocks.zh: 因此 RTU 容器的污染和鬆散玻璃缺陷，從「可接受（因為之後會洗）」升級為 Major A 或 Critical。
blocks.en: This is why contamination and loose glass defects in RTU containers are upgraded from "acceptable (because it will be washed later)" to Major A or Critical.

blocks.zh: Contamination Bulk vs RTU 分類對照
blocks.en: Contamination: Bulk vs RTU classification comparison

blocks.zh: 關鍵差異：RTU 容器對 "removable interior" 污染不再有 Minor 緩衝——因為洗滌步驟已不存在，所以即使理論上可移除，仍被視為不應出現。
blocks.en: Key difference: for "removable interior" contamination, RTU containers no longer have a Minor buffer. Because the washing step no longer exists, even contamination that is theoretically removable is still regarded as something that should not be present.

blocks.zh: 📚 教育解說 — RTU 特殊缺陷詳解
blocks.en: 📚 Educational Commentary — RTU-Specific Defects in Detail

blocks.zh: RTU 容器生命週期：從玻璃管到無菌交付
blocks.en: RTU container life cycle: from glass tubing to sterile delivery

blocks.zh: 理解 RTU 標準為何更嚴格，必須先了解其製程流程：
blocks.en: To understand why the RTU criteria are stricter, you must first understand its process flow:

blocks.zh: 玻璃管製造：熔融玻璃拉成管材（tubing cane）
blocks.en: Glass tubing manufacture: molten glass is drawn into tubing (tubing cane)

blocks.zh: 成型轉換：管材切割、加熱成型為小瓶（Converting）
blocks.en: Forming/conversion: the tubing is cut and heat-formed into vials (Converting)

blocks.zh: 退火：在 Lehr 中消除殘餘應力（Annealing）
blocks.en: Annealing: residual stress is relieved in the lehr (Annealing)

blocks.zh: 洗滌：WFI 超音波清洗（Washing — RTU 專有步驟）
blocks.en: Washing: ultrasonic washing with WFI (Washing — an RTU-specific step)

blocks.zh: 矽化：內壁塗覆矽油（Siliconization — 部分 RTU）
blocks.en: Siliconization: silicone oil is applied to the inner wall (Siliconization — some RTU)

blocks.zh: 除熱原：高溫滅菌爐（Depyrogenation — 250°C+）
blocks.en: Depyrogenation: high-temperature depyrogenation oven (Depyrogenation — 250°C+)

blocks.zh: 包裝：在 ISO 5 層流下，置入托盤/巢架，密封包裝
blocks.en: Packaging: under ISO 5 laminar flow, the vials are placed in trays/nests and sealed

blocks.zh: 出貨至製藥廠：直接進入灌裝線（無洗滌步驟）
blocks.en: Shipment to the pharmaceutical plant: goes directly onto the filling line (no washing step)

blocks.zh: 步驟 4–7 由玻璃製造商完成。製藥廠進行的是步驟 8 → 直接灌裝。
blocks.en: Steps 4–7 are performed by the glass manufacturer. The pharmaceutical plant performs step 8 → direct filling.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ Loose Glass RTU vs Bulk 的分類差異
blocks.en: ⚠️ Classification difference between Loose Glass RTU and Bulk

blocks.zh: Loose Glass (Bulk)：分類為 Minor（可移除）
blocks.en: Loose Glass (Bulk): classified as Minor (removable)

blocks.zh: 理由：下游洗滌步驟可清除，風險可忽略。
blocks.en: Rationale: the downstream washing step can remove it, so the risk is negligible.

blocks.zh: Loose Glass (RTU)：分類為
blocks.en: Loose Glass (RTU): classified as

blocks.zh: 理由：RTU 容器已完成洗滌，任何剩餘鬆散玻璃粒均代表洗滌過程失效，且製藥廠無機會清除。
blocks.en: Rationale: RTU containers have already been washed, so any remaining loose glass particles indicate a failure of the washing process, and the pharmaceutical plant has no opportunity to remove them.

blocks.zh: 這是 TR43 中最直接體現「製程風險轉移」概念的雙條目設計。
blocks.en: This dual-entry design is the most direct expression in TR43 of the concept of "process risk transfer".

blocks.zh: 💡 Haze vs Alkali Spots vs Treatment Bloom：如何區分？
blocks.en: 💡 Haze vs Alkali Spots vs Treatment Bloom: how to tell them apart?

blocks.zh: 三個外觀相似的缺陷，卻有截然不同的分類：
blocks.en: Three defects with a similar appearance have very different classifications:

blocks.zh: Treatment Bloom：Acceptable — 這是脫鹼處理（ammonium sulfate/dealkalization）的正常副產物，是「好的霧狀」，代表容器表面已被改質以降低化學反應性。
blocks.en: Treatment Bloom: Acceptable — this is a normal by-product of dealkalization treatment (ammonium sulfate / dealkalization). It is a "good haze", indicating that the container surface has been modified to reduce chemical reactivity.

blocks.zh: Alkali Spots：若不可移除且失敗 USP<660> → Critical — 玻璃成分在成型時蒸發後冷凝在表面，代表玻璃化學穩定性不足。
blocks.en: Alkali Spots: if not removable and failing USP<660> → Critical — glass constituents evaporate during forming and condense on the surface, indicating insufficient chemical stability of the glass.

blocks.zh: Haze：若不可移除且失敗 USP<660> → Critical — 更大面積的揮發性玻璃成分沉積，同樣代表水解阻力問題。
blocks.en: Haze: if not removable and failing USP<660> → Critical — a larger-area deposit of volatilized glass constituents, likewise indicating a hydrolytic resistance problem.

blocks.zh: 判斷關鍵：先做可移除性測試（80°C WFI 沖洗），再做 USP<660> 水解阻力測試。
blocks.en: Key to the judgement: perform the removability test first (rinse with 80°C WFI), then the USP<660> hydrolytic resistance test.

blocks.zh: Broken Ringoff（環形斷裂）：管制小瓶特有的失效模式
blocks.en: Broken Ringoff: a failure mode specific to tubular vials

blocks.zh: Broken Ringoff 是管制小瓶特有的缺陷，肩部或底部附近出現水平環形裂紋，最終可能分裂成兩段。
blocks.en: Broken Ringoff is a defect specific to tubular vials, in which a horizontal circumferential crack appears near the shoulder or bottom and may eventually split the vial into two pieces.

blocks.zh: 根本原因：成型時在肩部下方或底跟上方形成的殘餘熱應力，若退火過程不充分，應力無法釋放，形成「定時炸彈」。
blocks.en: Root cause: residual thermal stress formed during forming below the shoulder or above the heel. If annealing is insufficient, the stress cannot be relieved, creating a "time bomb".

blocks.zh: 偏振光檢測：TR43 特別指出可使用偏振光應變儀 (Polarimeter/Strain Viewer) 在未斷裂的容器上目視確認殘餘熱應力模式，是獨特的非破壞性預防性品管手段。
blocks.en: Polarized light inspection: TR43 specifically notes that a polarimeter / strain viewer can be used on unbroken containers to visually confirm the residual thermal stress pattern, a unique non-destructive, preventive quality control tool.

blocks.zh: 📚 TR43 整體知識整合
blocks.en: 📚 Integrating the Overall Knowledge of TR43

blocks.zh: TR43 的核心設計哲學：風險導向分類
blocks.en: The core design philosophy of TR43: risk-based classification

blocks.zh: TR43 不只是一本缺陷名稱詞典，更是一個基於風險的分類框架。每個缺陷的嚴重度分類（Critical / Major A / Major B / Minor / Acceptable）依據以下五個維度：
blocks.en: TR43 is not just a dictionary of defect names but a risk-based classification framework. The severity classification of each defect (Critical / Major A / Major B / Minor / Acceptable) is based on the following five dimensions:

blocks.zh: CCI/Sterility（容器密封完整性）：任何破壞密封的缺陷 → Critical
blocks.en: CCI/Sterility (container closure integrity): any defect that breaks the seal → Critical

blocks.zh: User Injury or Harm（使用者傷害）：導致患者受傷的缺陷 → Critical 或 Major A
blocks.en: User Injury or Harm: defects that cause patient injury → Critical or Major A

blocks.zh: Functional（功能性）：導致容器/系統無法使用 → Major A
blocks.en: Functional: renders the container/system unusable → Major A

blocks.zh: Machinability（機械加工性）：導致生產線損耗 → Major B
blocks.en: Machinability: causes losses on the production line → Major B

blocks.zh: Aesthetic（外觀）：不影響功能 → Minor 或 Acceptable
blocks.en: Aesthetic: does not affect function → Minor or Acceptable

blocks.zh: 這種框架與 ICH Q9 風險管理理念完全吻合，是 TR43 能成為業界標準的核心原因。
blocks.en: This framework is fully consistent with the ICH Q9 risk management approach and is the core reason TR43 has become an industry standard.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 各容器類型的獨特缺陷關注點速記
blocks.en: ⚠️ Quick reference: unique defect concerns by container type

blocks.zh: 模製瓶 → 關注模具縫線、壁厚均一性
blocks.en: Moulded vials → focus on mould seams and wall thickness uniformity

blocks.zh: 安瓿 → 關注開瓶力/劃線環、焰封品質
blocks.en: Ampoules → focus on opening force / score ring and flame-seal quality

blocks.zh: 卡匣管 → 關注活塞接觸面 (By-pass)、完成端密封
blocks.en: Cartridge tubes → focus on the stopper contact surface (By-pass) and finish-end sealing

blocks.zh: 預填充針筒 → 關注 Luer 錐管完整性、針頭組裝品質
blocks.en: Prefilled syringes → focus on luer cone integrity and needle assembly quality

blocks.zh: 管制小瓶 → 關注 RTU 潔淨度、環形斷裂、底部成型（凍乾）
blocks.en: Tubular vials → focus on RTU cleanliness, ring-off breakage and bottom forming (lyophilization)

blocks.zh: 考試常見題型：給定一個缺陷描述，要求判斷在哪種容器類型中嚴重度最高。答案往往是包含 RTU 處理步驟的容器，或密封面積最關鍵的容器。
blocks.en: Common exam question type: given a defect description, determine in which container type the severity is highest. The answer is often the container that includes RTU processing steps, or the container for which the sealing area is most critical.

blocks.zh: TR43 與其他 PDA 技術報告的連結
blocks.en: Links between TR43 and other PDA technical reports

blocks.zh: TR87（Glass Vial Handling）：處理 TR43 詞典中由「Handling」引起的缺陷的預防策略
blocks.en: TR87 (Glass Vial Handling): preventive strategies for defects in the TR43 lexicon that are caused by handling

blocks.zh: TR73（Prefilled Syringe）：延伸 TR43 Section 8.4 的系統整合和組件相容性
blocks.en: TR73 (Prefilled Syringe): extends TR43 Section 8.4 to system integration and component compatibility

blocks.zh: TR85（Visible Particle Detection）：TR43 Container Contamination 缺陷的下游可見異物管控
blocks.en: TR85 (Visible Particle Detection): downstream visible particle control for the TR43 container contamination defects

blocks.zh: TR90（CCS Development）：TR43 CCI-relevant defects 在容器密封系統開發中的應用
blocks.en: TR90 (CCS Development): application of the TR43 CCI-relevant defects in container closure system development

blocks.zh: USP <660> / Ph. Eur. 3.2.1：TR43 直接引用作為 Haze / Alkali Spots 的 Critical 判斷依據
blocks.en: USP <660> / Ph. Eur. 3.2.1: cited directly by TR43 as the basis for the Critical judgement of Haze / Alkali Spots

blocks.zh: 練習題組 A：分類判斷（管制小瓶）
blocks.en: Practice Question Set A: Classification Judgement (Tubular Vials)

blocks.zh: 進廠驗收時，發現一批 RTU 管制小瓶，在 5 個容器的內壁發現直徑約 0.2 mm 的白色不可移除圓形殘留物。進行 80°C WFI 沖洗後無法去除，但 USP<660> 表面玻璃測試通過。請問這批容器的這個缺陷應分類為何？應採取何種行動？
blocks.en: During incoming inspection, a batch of RTU tubular vials is found in which 5 containers have white, non-removable, round residues about 0.2 mm in diameter on the inner wall. The residues could not be removed by rinsing with 80°C WFI, but the USP<660> surface glass test passed. How should this defect be classified for this batch? What action should be taken?

blocks.zh: 一批 RTU 小瓶在目視檢查時，發現瓶底有鬆散玻璃粒（非黏附），可以用氣流吹走。請問這與傳統 Bulk 未洗滌小瓶的分類有何不同？為何？
blocks.en: During visual inspection, a batch of RTU vials is found with loose (non-adhered) glass particles at the bottom of the vial that can be blown away with an air stream. How does this differ from the classification for conventional Bulk unwashed vials, and why?

blocks.zh: 發現小瓶頸部下方約 1/2 位置有明顯肉眼可見的環形裂縫，容器尚未斷裂，且無明顯外力損傷痕跡。請問這最可能是哪個 TR43 缺陷？根本原因和分類為何？
blocks.en: A clearly visible circumferential crack is found at about 1/2 of the way down from below the neck of a vial. The container has not broken, and there are no obvious signs of external impact damage. Which TR43 defect is this most likely to be? What are the root cause and classification?

blocks.zh: 練習題組 B：跨容器類型比較
blocks.en: Practice Question Set B: Cross-Container Comparison

blocks.zh:
下列缺陷在哪種容器類型中嚴重度最高，為何？
(a) Contamination with a 0.15 mm² plastic fiber on internal surface (non-tooling origin)
(b) A 0.4 mm check in the body glass
(c) A crack in the glass wall
blocks.en:
In which container type is the severity of each of the following defects highest, and why?
(a) Contamination with a 0.15 mm² plastic fiber on internal surface (non-tooling origin)
(b) A 0.4 mm check in the body glass
(c) A crack in the glass wall

blocks.zh: 預填充針筒的 Cone Incomplete 缺陷，其 Critical 定義與管制小瓶的 Chip（Critical 定義）有何本質上的相似之處？
blocks.en: What is the essential similarity between the Critical definition of Cone Incomplete in the prefilled syringe and the Critical definition of Chip in the tubular vial?

blocks.zh: TR43 定義安瓿的 Spiticule 為 Major A，而管制小瓶的 Spiticule 也是 Major A，但兩者的「理由」（Risk/Impact）是否相同？請解釋。
blocks.en: TR43 defines Spiticule as Major A for ampoules, and Spiticule is also Major A for tubular vials, but is the "rationale" (risk/impact) the same for both? Please explain.

blocks.zh: 📚 實務應用：CDMO 進廠驗收策略
blocks.en: 📚 Practical Application: CDMO Incoming Inspection Strategy

blocks.zh: 如何在 CDMO QC 計畫中應用 TR43
blocks.en: How to apply TR43 in a CDMO QC plan

blocks.zh: Step 1 — 建立驗收標準 (Acceptance Criteria)
blocks.en: Step 1 — Establish Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 與玻璃供應商共同依據 TR43 詞典，為每個缺陷條目設定接收標準（是否允許、允許數量）
blocks.en: Together with the glass supplier, set acceptance criteria for each defect entry based on the TR43 lexicon (whether permitted, and the permitted quantity)

blocks.zh: Critical 缺陷：允許數量 = 0（零缺陷政策）
blocks.en: Critical defects: permitted quantity = 0 (zero-defect policy)

blocks.zh: Major A：通常 AQL = 0.65%（依 ISO 2859-1）
blocks.en: Major A: typically AQL = 0.65% (per ISO 2859-1)

blocks.zh: Major B：通常 AQL = 1.0%
blocks.en: Major B: typically AQL = 1.0%

blocks.zh: Minor：通常 AQL = 4.0%（或依合約協議）
blocks.en: Minor: typically AQL = 4.0% (or per contractual agreement)

blocks.zh: Acceptable Imperfection：無需計數
blocks.en: Acceptable Imperfection: no counting required

blocks.zh: Step 2 — 區分 RTU vs Bulk 驗收計畫
blocks.en: Step 2 — Separate RTU and Bulk acceptance plans

blocks.zh: RTU 容器需要獨立的 SOP 和驗收標準，不能直接套用 Bulk 標準
blocks.en: RTU containers need a separate SOP and acceptance criteria; the Bulk criteria cannot be applied directly

blocks.zh: 關鍵差異條目：Contamination (RTU)、Loose Glass (RTU)，需在驗收標準中明確列出 RTU 版本
blocks.en: Key differing entries: Contamination (RTU) and Loose Glass (RTU); the RTU versions must be explicitly listed in the acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: RTU 驗收通常在供應商已執行 Certificate of Analysis (CoA) 的基礎上，進行跳批次抽樣（Skip Lot Testing）
blocks.en: RTU acceptance is usually performed as skip-lot testing on the basis of the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) that the supplier has already executed

blocks.zh: Step 3 — 量測方法確認
blocks.en: Step 3 — Confirm measurement methods

blocks.zh: TR43 對每個缺陷都指定量測方法（目視、放大鏡、卡尺、量規、CCI 測試等）
blocks.en: TR43 specifies a measurement method for each defect (visual, magnifier, caliper, gauge, CCI test, etc.)

blocks.zh: 驗收 SOP 應引用 TR43 的量測方法，確保 QC 人員訓練一致性
blocks.en: The acceptance SOP should cite the TR43 measurement methods to ensure consistent QC personnel training

blocks.zh: 限量樣品 (Limit Sample) 的建立：TR43 許多 Minor 條目要求建立實物限量樣品
blocks.en: Establishing limit samples: many Minor entries in TR43 require physical limit samples to be established

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見情境決策樹
blocks.en: Common CDMO scenario decision tree

blocks.zh: 情境：收到一批管制小瓶，目視檢查發現異常。
blocks.en: Scenario: a batch of tubular vials is received and visual inspection finds an anomaly.

blocks.zh: 識別缺陷 → 對照 TR43 Section 8.5 詞典確認名稱
blocks.en: Identify the defect → confirm the name against the TR43 Section 8.5 lexicon

blocks.zh: 確認是 Bulk 還是 RTU → 查看供應商 CoA 和容器規格
blocks.en: Confirm whether it is Bulk or RTU → check the supplier CoA and container specification

blocks.zh: 量測確認 → 依 TR43 指定方法測量尺寸、確認可移除性
blocks.en: Confirm by measurement → measure dimensions and confirm removability using the method specified in TR43

blocks.zh: 確認分類等級（Critical/Major A/B/Minor/Acceptable）
blocks.en: Confirm the classification level (Critical/Major A/B/Minor/Acceptable)

blocks.zh: 比較 AQL 抽樣結果 → 是否超出允收數量
blocks.en: Compare the AQL sampling result → does it exceed the acceptance number

blocks.zh:
決定：
— Critical 發現 → 即時隔離、通知供應商、拒收
— Major 超標 → 不符合項 (Nonconformance) 調查、可能拒收
— Minor 超標 → 評估風險、可能放行附條件或拒收
— Acceptable → 記錄，放行
blocks.en:
Decide:
— Critical finding → immediate quarantine, notify the supplier, reject
— Major exceeds limit → nonconformance investigation, possible rejection
— Minor exceeds limit → assess risk, possible conditional release or rejection
— Acceptable → record and release

blocks.zh: 必要時啟動 CAPA 並要求供應商根因分析
blocks.en: If necessary, initiate a CAPA and require a root cause analysis from the supplier

blocks.zh: USP <660> / Ph. Eur. 3.2.1A 在 TR43 中的角色
blocks.en: The role of USP <660> / Ph. Eur. 3.2.1A in TR43

blocks.zh: TR43 是少數在視覺缺陷分類中直接引用化學測試標準的指引。
blocks.en: TR43 is one of the few guidelines that directly cites a chemical test standard in a visual defect classification.

blocks.zh: 對於 Alkali Spots 和 Haze，TR43 設計了三層判斷邏輯：
blocks.en: For Alkali Spots and Haze, TR43 designs a three-tier decision logic:

blocks.zh: 可移除？ → 若是：Acceptable（或 Minor）；若否，進入下一層
blocks.en: Removable? → if yes: Acceptable (or Minor); if no, go to the next tier

blocks.zh: 化學成分是否為純玻璃成分（glass constituents only）？ → 若含非玻璃外來物：改分類為 Contamination（更高嚴重度）
blocks.en: Are the chemical constituents glass constituents only? → if it contains non-glass foreign material: reclassify as Contamination (higher severity)

blocks.zh: 通過 USP <660> 水解阻力測試？ → 若通過：Minor；若失敗：Critical
blocks.en: Does it pass the USP <660> hydrolytic resistance test? → if it passes: Minor; if it fails: Critical

blocks.zh: 這種設計體現了 TR43「外觀缺陷需結合功能風險評估」的核心哲學。
blocks.en: This design reflects the core TR43 philosophy that "cosmetic defects must be combined with a functional risk assessment".

blocks.zh: TR43 完整學習總結 — 五種容器類型不符合項詞典綜合摘要
blocks.en: TR43 Complete Learning Summary — Consolidated Summary of the Nonconformity Lexicons for the Five Container Types

blocks.zh: 核心知識點回顧
blocks.en: Review of core knowledge points

blocks.zh: TR43 (Revised 2023) 為五種玻璃初級包裝容器建立了統一的不符合項詞典，涵蓋定義、分類、量測方法、相關缺陷及風險影響。
blocks.en: TR43 (Revised 2023) establishes a unified nonconformity lexicon for five glass primary packaging container types, covering definitions, classification, measurement methods, related defects and risk impact.

blocks.zh: 分類等級架構：Critical → Major A → Major B → Minor → Acceptable Imperfection，反映 CCI/使用者安全 → 功能 → 機械加工 → 外觀的風險層級。
blocks.en: Classification level structure: Critical → Major A → Major B → Minor → Acceptable Imperfection, reflecting the risk hierarchy of CCI/user safety → function → machinability → appearance.

blocks.zh: RTU（Ready-to-Use）容器的雙版本條目設計（Bulk vs RTU），體現「下游製程風險緩解能力」對缺陷嚴重度評估的根本影響。
blocks.en: The dual-version entry design for RTU (Ready-to-Use) containers (Bulk vs RTU) reflects the fundamental influence of "downstream process risk mitigation capability" on the severity assessment of defects.

blocks.zh: Crack 在所有五種容器類型中均為 Critical，是最一致的跨容器通則。
blocks.en: Crack is Critical in all five container types, the most consistent cross-container rule.

blocks.zh: USP <660>/Ph. Eur. 3.2.1A 水解阻力測試直接整合入 Haze 和 Alkali Spots 的分類判斷邏輯中。
blocks.en: The USP <660>/Ph. Eur. 3.2.1A hydrolytic resistance test is integrated directly into the classification logic for Haze and Alkali Spots.

blocks.zh: 管制小瓶特有缺陷摘要
blocks.en: Summary of defects specific to tubular vials

blocks.zh: Broken Ringoff：環形斷裂，管制小瓶特有，源於轉換過程熱應力，偏振光可預防性偵測。
blocks.en: Broken Ringoff: circumferential break, specific to tubular vials, arising from thermal stress during conversion and detectable preventively with polarized light.

blocks.zh: Concave Bottom（Push Up）：底部向內凸起超標，影響凍乾製程與填充針。
blocks.en: Concave Bottom (Push Up): excessive inward bulging of the bottom, affecting the lyophilization process and filling needles.

blocks.zh: Treatment Bloom：脫鹼處理正常副產物，唯一被定義為 Acceptable Imperfection 的霧狀外觀缺陷。
blocks.en: Treatment Bloom: a normal by-product of dealkalization treatment and the only haze-like cosmetic defect defined as an Acceptable Imperfection.

blocks.zh: Contamination RTU vs Bulk：最重要的雙版本條目，RTU 無洗滌下游緩解，嚴重度升高。
blocks.en: Contamination RTU vs Bulk: the most important dual-version entry; RTU has no downstream washing mitigation, so the severity is raised.

blocks.zh: Alkali Spots / Haze：三步判斷法（可移除性 → 成分識別 → USP<660>測試），Critical 與 Minor 的判斷依賴化學分析。
blocks.en: Alkali Spots / Haze: three-step judgement (removability → composition identification → USP<660> test); the determination of Critical vs Minor depends on chemical analysis.

blocks.zh: 本節完成 PDA TR43 (Revised 2023) 所有五個容器類型的不符合項詞典學習。完整學習後，讀者應能獨立進行玻璃容器進廠驗收、不符合項識別與分類，並理解各缺陷背後的製程起源與患者安全風險。
blocks.en: This section completes the study of the nonconformity lexicons for all five container types in PDA TR43 (Revised 2023). After completing the full course, the reader should be able to independently perform incoming inspection of glass containers, identify and classify nonconformities, and understand the process origin and patient safety risk behind each defect.
